items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And he also had Al Sears in the band. I didn't find this out until later, that Al Sears was in the band.

ctx.x: And Joe Garland. And he also had Al Sears in the band. I didn't find this out until later, that Al Sears was in the band. So he needed a third alto player. So he sent for me.
So you three cats played together with Jelly Roll Morton?
